title: United Metals
description: Allows you to use any metal in general metal requiring recipes.
body:
## Summary
Aren't you tired of being forced to use a certain type of _metal_ while crafting while any kind metal would do just fine? Well United Metals aims to fix that. This project lets you craft stuff that could have been forced to a certain kind of metal _**with any metal**_. Times of using gold to crafting an spyglass or iron to craft a bucket is over my friend! 

## Which Crafting Recipes?
 Every version should have the crafting recipe list in their changelogs.

##  Why Is There a Mod Version?
I also created an version where it checks for tag:metal so that other metals from other mods can also be used.
